info.title: Paolo Ronco public articles API
info.description: Read published technical articles in Italian or English. No authentication or write operations. Content usage: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no.

get.description: Returns all published articles in the requested language, newest first. Prefer the per-page Markdown alternate for a single article. Missing or unrecognized lang values fall back to Italian. Responses may be cached for 300 seconds.

200.description: Published articles, including their canonical page paths and Markdown content.

markdown.description: Article title, metadata and body in Markdown.

href.description: Root-relative canonical page path in the requested language.
